1.title: Interval Running
1.description: Alternating fast running (30 sec) and slow (30 sec) for 20 minutes. Excellent for developing cardio endurance for hockey.
instructions: Start with 5-minute warm-up with light running
Perform 30 seconds of fast running (80-90% of maximum speed)
Switch to 30 seconds of slow running for recovery
tips: Watch your breathing - breathe deeply and rhythmically
If tired, you can increase recovery time

2.title: Burpee with Jump
2.description: Complex exercise: squat → plank → push-up → squat → jump. Perform 3 sets of 10-15 repetitions.
instructions: Squat down, placing palms on the floor in front of you
Push your feet back, assuming plank position
Pull your feet back to your hands, staying in squat
Jump up, raising your arms overhead
tips: Keep your back straight at all stages
Start with 5-8 repetitions and gradually increase

3.title: Cycling
3.description: Intensive cycling or stationary bike with high-intensity intervals. 5 minutes warm-up, 20 minutes intervals.
tips: Watch your body position - keep back straight

4.title: Plyometric Jumps
4.description: Jumps in place with maximum height, landing on semi-bent legs. 3 sets of 15-20 jumps.
instructions: Explosively jump up, extending your arms

5.title: Short Distance Sprints
5.description: Running at maximum speed for 20-30 meters with 30 seconds rest between runs. 8-10 runs.
instructions: Run at maximum speed on signal

6.title: Ball Throws to Wall
6.description: Throwing medicine ball to wall with maximum force, catching and throwing again. 3 sets of 20 throws.
instructions: Hold the ball with both hands at chest level
Explosively straighten your legs and arms, throwing the ball
tips: Work with your whole body, not just your arms

7.title: Dynamic Leg Stretching
7.description: Leg swings forward, backward and sideways, circular movements in hip joints. 10-15 repetitions each leg.
instructions: Perform 10-15 forward swings with right leg
Perform 10-15 backward swings with right leg
Perform 10-15 sideways swings with right leg
Perform circular movements in hip joints

8.title: Upper Body Warm-up
8.description: Circular arm movements, torso bends, turns. Warming up shoulder joints and back.
instructions: Perform 10 torso bends to the sides

9.title: Light Running in Place
9.description: Running in place with high knee lifts, gradual pace increase. 5-7 minutes.
instructions: Start with light running in place
Work your arms as in regular running
Slow down in the last 2 minutes

10.title: Static Leg Muscle Stretching
10.description: Holding stretching positions for quadriceps, calf muscles and adductors. 30 seconds for each group.
instructions: Quadriceps stretch: stand on one leg, bend the other back
Calf stretch: lunge forward, keeping back leg straight
Adductor stretch: sit down, spread legs to the sides
tips: Don't stretch to the point of pain

11.title: Back and Shoulder Stretching
11.description: Forward bends, chest muscle stretching, triceps stretching. Hold each position for 20-30 seconds.

12.title: Yoga for Hockey Players
12.description: Complex of asanas for developing flexibility and balance: warrior pose, tree pose, downward dog pose.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

13.title: Coordination Ladder
13.description: Quick foot movements through ladder: lateral steps, crossover steps, jumps. 3 passes of each type.

14.title: Ball Juggling
14.description: Juggling 2-3 tennis balls for developing hand-eye coordination. Start with 1 ball.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

15.title: Quick Cone Touches
15.description: Set up 5-6 cones and quickly touch them with hand in random order. 3 sets of 30 seconds.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

16.title: Rowing Machine
16.description: Interval rowing: 2 minutes high intensity, 1 minute rest. 8-10 cycles for endurance development.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

17.title: Interval Jump Rope
17.description: Alternating fast jumps (30 sec) and slow (30 sec). 20 minutes for cardio endurance development.
instructions: Take a jump rope of suitable length
30 seconds of fast jumps at maximum speed
30 seconds of slow jumps for recovery
tips: Work with your wrists, not your arms

18.title: Stair Running
18.description: Running up stairs at maximum speed, walking down. 10-15 climbs for leg endurance development.
tips: Use your entire foot when climbing

19.title: Plank with Movements
19.description: Holding plank with alternating arm and leg lifts. 3 sets of 45-60 seconds for core strengthening.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

20.title: High Knee Running
20.description: Running in place with maximum knee lifts to chest. 5 sets of 2 minutes with 1 minute rest.

21.title: Standing Long Jump
21.description: Forward jumps with maximum distance, landing on both feet. 5 sets of 8-10 jumps.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

22.title: Fast Push-ups
22.description: Push-ups at maximum speed, touching chest to floor. 4 sets of 15-20 repetitions.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

23.title: Obstacle Jumps
23.description: Jumping over cones or barriers 30-40 cm high. 3 passes of 10 obstacles.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

24.title: Fast Squats
24.description: Squats at maximum speed, thighs parallel to floor. 4 sets of 20-25 repetitions.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

25.title: Medicine Ball Throws
25.description: Throwing heavy ball (5-8 kg) from chest with maximum force. 3 sets of 15 throws.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

26.title: Ankle Warm-up
26.description: Circular foot movements, toe flexion-extension. 2-3 minutes for each foot.
instructions: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
tips: Give enough time to each movement

27.title: Neck Warm-up
27.description: Smooth head turns, forward-backward bends, circular movements. 2-3 minutes.
instructions: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
tips: Give enough time to each movement

28.title: Wrist Warm-up

instructions: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
tips: Give enough time to each movement

29.title: Knee Warm-up

instructions: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
tips: Give enough time to each movement

30.title: Hip Joint Warm-up
30.description: Circular hip movements, leg swings to sides, light lunges. 4-5 minutes.
instructions: Start slowly and gradually increase intensity
tips: Give enough time to each movement

31.title: Groin Stretching
31.description: Butterfly - sitting on floor, connect feet and bend forward. Hold for 30-45 seconds.

32.title: Hamstring Stretching
32.description: Forward bends to straight legs, hold for 30 seconds. 3 sets of 15 seconds.

33.title: Calf Muscle Stretching
33.description: Lunges with wall support, stretching back of shin. 20 seconds for each leg.

34.title: Chest Muscle Stretching
34.description: Wall stretching with arms pulled back. Hold for 30 seconds, 3 sets.

35.title: Triceps Stretching
35.description: Bringing arm behind head, stretching back of shoulder. 20 seconds for each arm.

36.title: Cone Slalom
36.description: Running slalom between cones placed in line. 5 passes at maximum speed.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

37.title: Quick Foot Touches
37.description: Quick touches of cones with feet in random order. 3 sets of 45 seconds.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

38.title: Jumps with Turns
38.description: Jumps in place with 90-180 degree turns. 3 sets of 20 jumps.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

39.title: Fast Ball Passing
39.description: Passing tennis ball between hands at maximum speed. 3 sets of 1 minute.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

40.title: Backward Running
40.description: Running backward with quick turns on signal. 5 sets of 30 seconds.

41.title: Weighted Squats
41.description: Squats with dumbbells or barbell, thighs parallel to floor. 4 sets of 12-15 repetitions.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

47.description: Holding plank with one leg lifted. 3 sets of 30 seconds each leg.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

48.title: Single Leg Squats
48.description: Squats on one leg with other leg extended forward. 3 sets of 8-10 repetitions each leg.
tips: Start with lighter weight and increase gradually

49.title: BOSU Ball Exercises
49.description: Exercises on unstable surface for balance development. 15-20 minutes of various movements.

puckSpeed.title: Puck Speed Measurement
puckSpeed.instructionWarning: Attention! Accurate speed is guaranteed only in the absence of extraneous sounds and when using 2 lapel microphones. Please record only correct speeds in the results!
puckSpeed.instruction1: Measure the distance from the net to the shot location and enter it in the distance field
puckSpeed.instruction2: Place the phone equidistant from the shot location and the goal, or place one lapel mic near the shot location and secure the second one in a safe place on the net
puckSpeed.instruction3: Shoot the puck - the radar counts the time of impact and goal entry and calculates the speed
puckSpeed.instruction4: Make several attempts - select the correct speed and add it to your profile
puckSpeed.instruction5: Adjust sensitivity if speed is calculated incorrectly.
puckSpeed.instruction6: Choose the correct and best speed to add to profile
puckSpeed.errorNoProfile: You must be logged in to save the result
puckSpeed.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this record?
puckSpeed.speedExceedsLimit: Speed exceeds 120 km/h, measurement not counted
puckSpeed.puckInFrame: 🎯 Object in frame - waiting for exit...
puckSpeed.cameraInstructions:
HOW TO USE:

1. Position the phone so that an object (puck, ball, etc.) flies through the frame
2. Measure the distance (width of detection zone): 80 cm
3. Press START
4. Quickly throw the object through the frame (don't stop it in the frame!)

💡 You can use any object: puck, ball, tennis ball, etc.
